thread_title: Hi! need some advice with pulls and team building :D

content:
Idk if you still need advice, but here's some general tips:

Standard pulls are meant to be used, and you are purposefully given tons of them through dailies and story progression. Don't feel afraid to use them. There are many options you can use them on; namely, banner characters or wheel jail. It's typically recommended to get a full roster of characters (i.e. a majority of the standards) before you move onto wheel jail so you can use those characters in future D-Zone comps. After you feel like you have a sufficient amount, move onto wheel jail where you try and get a SSR wheel to +12 so you can use 2 SSR wheels at once. The SSR wheel most people go with is Blade of the Titans since it is a widely applicable DPS wheel.

Lotan's wheel is good for her, but there's also other replacements that can be used. If you enjoy using Glotan and want to use her more, pulling her wheel is fine. In my opinion though, Moonless Guide will ultimately give your account more progression since none of those characters (especially Thais and Horla) are not at their breakpoints yet. 

If you want to build a team, I suggest reading on this guide what a common team typically includes. If you still have questions, feel free to ask.
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1THjxR9hHs4NWHqSWHHa2dHAGuE_cRGelfzXdBfCnIlM/edit?tab=t.9ndp3ofgzwqw#heading=h.ldpml1aidj5h

In this guide, it also goes over wheel suggestions in-depth. To oversimplify: if you are in arc 1, take advantage and use the R wheels on your supports since they are very strong.
